fields.response: inspect the serialized metadata header to determine the key's arity and component primitive types, dynamically construct the corresponding typed ShardKey<...> from the retained byte payload when the bytes represent a valid serialized key, and format the untyped key via ToString using its shardId and decoded record, child, grandchild, and great-grandchild components (or return '{ Empty ShardKey }' when empty and '{ Not a ShardKey }' when the buffer cannot be decoded as a valid ShardKey)
fields.subject: ShardKeys.GhostShardKey
fields.trigger: GetInstance or ToString is invoked on a GhostShardKey
